title.narrative: Multisector and Integrated Life Saving Support (MILSS) for vulnerable communities in drought affected district of Karat Zuria, Konso in SNNPR.

description.narrative:
ltpgtltbrgt
lt/pgtltpgtThe overall objective of this multi-sectoral interventions is to provide humanitarian lifesaving services to drought and flood affected communities in Konso/Karat Zuria districts of SNNPR through integrated Agriculture, WASH, Protection and Multipurpose cash interventions to reach a total of 63,110 direct beneficiaries (24,384 men, 19,545 women, 10,646 boys, and 8,535 girls). 181 persons with disabilities are also targeted. The proposed interventions will not only focus on services provision but also focuses on durable solution where the services are sustainable. The integrated multi-sectoral approach will ensure beneficiaries are receiving holistic benefits hence contributing towards alleviating human suffering as well as promoting human wellbeing. The project will be implemented by consortium of one international NGO -VSF Germany (a lead) and one national NGOs named Women Empowerment – Action (WE-Action). We -Action is a national NGO established in 1995 with vision of Empower Men and Women for Gender Transformation and Sustained Livelihood. WE-Action has strong ground presence in the targeted districts and is in charge of protection components of the project. VSF Germany is a lead of the consortium and has strong presence in the targeted districts including Animal health project in Konos and karat Zuria funded by USAID-BHA via FAO. VSF Germany in charge of agriculture WASH and Multipurpose Cash components of the project including cross cutting activities of the project. The program will address the immediate needs priorities of the targeted communities with lifesaving to medium-term needs. As described in the sectors below, Agriculture, WASH, Multipurpose cash protection components are integrated so that the affected households will benefit from more than one intervention to serve them more holistically enhance the project effectiveness the multiplier effects. The activities of the project are designed to meet immediate lifesaving and emergency needs of drought, conflict and flood affected people of Karat Zuria district with emphasis to most vulnerable people groups mainly women, girls, children, people with disabilities and others with special needs by employing approaches like gender sensitive, Do No Harm, inclusive project implementation. The Agriculture sector intervention will have the following key components: Support to Agro-pastoralist in crops and vegetables production to address their household food and income needs through provision of farming inputs such as improved seeds, tools, extension training services pastoralists through veterinary support (i.e. vaccination, animal treatment training services) agro-pastoralists, pastoralists, people with disabilities and special needs through multipurpose cash and protection services. Protection sector will contribute in reducing physical and psychosocial insecurity of drought, conflict and flood affected people in the targeted districts through protection monitoring, GBV, and child protection responsive actions. Whereas WASH interventions will help to improve inclusive access to protected water sources, basic sanitation facilities and adopt good hygiene practices through provision of timely multi-sectoral life-saving assistance.lt/pgt
